Pack D11_1 (passes): a green enchantment, a white artifact, a red creature and a colorless artifact creature are refused; a green-and-white creature is a legal target and the only one destroyed. Pack D11_2 (passes): it is a sorcery, refused on the opponent's turn ('window:not_your_turn') and cast on seat 0's own turn.
